title: X-Men '97

fullSynopsis: Continuing the beloved 1992 animated continuity, Cyclops and Storm lead the mutants through the devastating Genosha sentinel massacre, Magneto’s worldwide EMP, and Bastion’s Prime Sentinels.
director: Jake Castorena, Chase Conley, Emi Yonemura
castMembers: Ray Chase, Jennifer Hale, Alison Sealy-Smith, Cal Dodd, J.P. Karliak, Lenore Zann, George Buza, A.J. LoCascio, Holly Chou, Matthew Waterson
postCreditScene: Apocalypse visits ruined Genosha and picks up one of Gambit’s burnt playing cards.

title: Deadpool & Wolverine
shortSynopsis: Wade Wilson’s peaceful life is interrupted when the TVA recruits him to save his dying timeline alongside Wolverine.
fullSynopsis: When TVA Agent Paradox prepares to eradicate Earth-10005 due to the loss of anchor being Logan, Deadpool ventures into the Multiverse Void, teaming up with a depressed Wolverine, Blade, Elektra, and Gambit to overthrow Cassandra Nova.
writers: Ryan Reynolds, Rhett Reese, Paul Wernick, Zeb Wells, Shawn Levy
castMembers: Ryan Reynolds, Hugh Jackman, Emma Corrin, Matthew Macfadyen, Dafne Keen, Channing Tatum, Wesley Snipes, Jennifer Garner
postCreditScene: Deadpool plays archival tape in the TVA proving Johnny Storm was genuinely talking trash about Cassandra Nova.

title: Agatha All Along
shortSynopsis: Agatha Harkness breaks free of the Westview spell and gathers a ragtag coven of witches to face the treacherous Witches’ Road.
fullSynopsis: Stripped of her magic by Wanda, Agatha is freed by an enigmatic teen revealed to be Billy Maximoff (Wiccan). Together with a disparate coven, they descend the deadly Witches’ Road to restore their mystical abilities.
director: Jac Schaeffer, Rachel Goldberg, Gandja Monteiro
castMembers: Kathryn Hahn, Joe Locke, Sasheer Zamata, Ali Ahn, Maria Dizzia, Aubrey Plaza
postCreditScene: Ghost Agatha and Billy set out across the world to find Billy’s twin brother Tommy Maximoff (Speed).

title: What If...? (Season 3)
shortSynopsis: The culminating season of What If...? exploring mech Avengers, Storm wielding Mjolnir, and ultimate multiverse crossovers.
fullSynopsis: Concludes the animated multiverse trilogy as Uatu the Watcher witnesses the final convergence of alternate heroes before incursions collapse adjacent realities.
castMembers: Jeffrey Wright, David Harbour, Anthony Mackie, Sebastian Stan, Simu Liu
postCreditScene: Teases the cosmic Battleworld reality.

title: Captain America: Brave New World
shortSynopsis: Sam Wilson takes the shield into international intrigue, navigating an assassination attempt on President Ross and confronting Red Hulk.
fullSynopsis: Newly elected U.S. President Thaddeus Ross attempts to make Captain America an official military position. When a global conspiracy involving Celestial Island’s Adamantium emerges, Ross mutates into the rampaging Red Hulk.
writers: Malcolm Spellman, Dalan Musson, Matthew Orton
castMembers: Anthony Mackie, Harrison Ford, Danny Ramirez, Shira Haas, Giancarlo Esposito, Liv Tyler, Tim Blake Nelson
postCreditScene: Sam Wilson begins forming a new official Avengers roster to defend the globe.

title: Daredevil: Born Again (Season 1)
shortSynopsis: Matt Murdock and newly elected NYC Mayor Wilson Fisk navigate power struggles, street vigilantes, and corruption across New York City.
fullSynopsis: Matt Murdock attempts to put the cowl aside and serve as a lawyer alongside Karen Page and Foggy Nelson. But as Wilson Fisk takes office as Mayor and outlaws vigilantes, Murdock is dragged back into the bloody shadows of Hell’s Kitchen against Bullseye and the Punisher.
director: Justin Benson, Aaron Moorhead, Michael Cuesta
castMembers: Charlie Cox, Vincent D'Onofrio, Jon Bernthal, Deborah Ann Woll, Elden Henson, Wilson Bethel
postCreditScene: Wilson Fisk receives classified briefings on vigilante coordination in Queens, hinting at Spider-Man.

title: Thunderbolts*
shortSynopsis: An irreverent team of reformed anti-heroes and assassins are assembled for covert black-ops government missions.
fullSynopsis: Contessa Valentina Allegra de Fontaine deploys Yelena Belova, Bucky Barnes, John Walker (U.S. Agent), Red Guardian, Ghost, and Taskmaster into a covert death-trap facility, forcing the cynical misfits to band together when Bob (The Sentry) breaks loose.
writers: Eric Pearson, Lee Sung Jin, Joanna Calo
castMembers: Florence Pugh, Sebastian Stan, David Harbour, Wyatt Russell, Hannah John-Kamen, Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Lewis Pullman
postCreditScene: Bucky Barnes intercepts communications regarding anomalous multiverse energy spikes in the North Atlantic.

title: Ironheart
shortSynopsis: Genius inventor Riri Williams returns to Chicago, clashing technological innovation against the dark mystical arts of Parker Robbins (The Hood).
fullSynopsis: Following her technological exploits in Wakanda Forever, MIT prodigy Riri Williams builds her own state-of-the-art Ironheart armor suit, facing off against Parker Robbins (The Hood) who wields a demonic cloak.
castMembers: Dominique Thorne, Anthony Ramos, Alden Ehrenreich, Lyric Ross, Matthew Elam
postCreditScene: Parker Robbins hears the whispering voice of Mephisto from the ashes of his burning cloak.

title: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
shortSynopsis: Marvel’s First Family navigates a vibrant 1960s retro-futuristic alternate universe while confronting Galactus and the Silver Surfer.
fullSynopsis: Set in a stunning 1960s retro-future alternate timeline, Reed Richards (Mister Fantastic), Sue Storm (Invisible Woman), Johnny Storm (Human Torch), and Ben Grimm (The Thing) face the cosmic devourer Galactus. Their dimensional jump brings them directly into Earth-616.
writers: Josh Friedman, Jeff Kaplan, Ian Springer
castMembers: Pedro Pascal, Vanessa Kirby, Joseph Quinn, Ebon Moss-Bachrach, Ralph Ineson, Julia Garner
postCreditScene: The Baxter Building interdimensional portal tears open as Victor Von Doom observes Earth-616.

title: Daredevil: Born Again (Season 2)
shortSynopsis: The full-blown war for New York City escalates as Matt Murdock, Frank Castle, and city vigilantes fight Kingpin’s corrupt municipal police force.
fullSynopsis: Released in March 2026, Season 2 sees Mayor Fisk declare martial law on masked vigilantes across New York. Daredevil and the Punisher forge an uneasy alliance to dismantle underground syndicates before Fisk seizes absolute federal power.
castMembers: Charlie Cox, Vincent D'Onofrio, Jon Bernthal, Margarita Levieva, Michael Gandolfini
postCreditScene: Frank Castle establishes his underground armory as a mysterious red-suited spider swings past Manhattan billboards.

title: The Punisher: Special Presentation
originalTitle: Marvel Studios Special Presentation: The Punisher
shortSynopsis: Frank Castle conducts an uncompromising one-man siege against a corrupt cartel operation in a standalone Special Presentation.
fullSynopsis: A gritty, standalone 54-minute Special Presentation starring Jon Bernthal as Frank Castle. Set during the aftermath of Daredevil: Born Again Season 2, the Punisher hunts down weapons traffickers supplying illicit high-tech arms to New York gangs.
castMembers: Jon Bernthal, Ebon Moss-Bachrach (flashback), Amber Rose Revah
postCreditScene: Castle spray-paints the iconic skull insignia onto new tactical body armor.

title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
shortSynopsis: Peter Parker begins completely from scratch in NYC with no memories of his past, embracing raw street-level heroism against Kingpin and city syndicates.
fullSynopsis: Now playing in theaters following its September 30, 2026 premiere! Stripped of Stark technology, Peter Parker lives alone in a modest apartment with a self-sewn cloth suit. Navigating college and street-level crime, Peter battles Wilson Fisk’s enforcers while mysterious symbiote threads emerge in the shadows.
castMembers: Tom Holland, Zendaya, Vincent D'Onofrio, Mark Ruffalo, Sadie Sink
postCreditScene: A dark symbiote tendril attaches to Peter’s window sill as news monitors report anomalous green dimensional flashes over Latveria.

title: VisionQuest
shortSynopsis: White Vision embarks on a journey across the digital cosmos and human memory to reclaim his identity and humanity following Westview.
fullSynopsis: Debuting on Disney+ in 6 days on October 14, 2026! White Vision explores the origins of consciousness, wrestling with the memories of the synthezoid who died in Wakanda and the philosophical ghost of Tony Stark’s creation, setting the stage for Doomsday.
castMembers: Paul Bettany, James Spader (Ultron), Kerry Condon, Fionn O’Shea
postCreditScene: Pending series premiere on October 14, 2026.

title: Avengers: Doomsday
shortSynopsis: Earth’s Mightiest Heroes collide with Victor Von Doom as the fabric of the Multiverse collapses on December 18, 2026.
fullSynopsis: Directed by the Russo Brothers, Avengers: Doomsday unites the Avengers, the Fantastic Four, and multiverse champions against Doctor Doom (played by Robert Downey Jr.) as universal incursions threaten to annihilate all reality.
castMembers: Robert Downey Jr., Pedro Pascal, Benedict Cumberbatch, Anthony Mackie, Florence Pugh, Tom Holland
postCreditScene: The total collapse of the multiverse leads directly into the formation of Battleworld in Secret Wars.

title: Daredevil: Born Again (Season 3)
shortSynopsis: The post-Doomsday street-level landscape pushes Matt Murdock into the ultimate trial of faith and law across a fractured city.
fullSynopsis: Slated for release in March 2027 on Disney+, Season 3 concludes the monumental Born Again trilogy.
castMembers: Charlie Cox, Vincent D'Onofrio
postCreditScene: TBA

title: Avengers: Secret Wars
shortSynopsis: The monumental conclusion to the Multiverse Saga where colliding realities converge onto Battleworld in December 2027.
fullSynopsis: Directed by the Russo Brothers, Secret Wars resolves the incursion crisis on Battleworld, uniting characters from Earth-616, Fox’s X-Men universe, Sony’s Spider-Verse, and beyond in a climactic cosmic reset.
castMembers: Robert Downey Jr., Hugh Jackman, Tobey Maguire, Andrew Garfield, Pedro Pascal, Ryan Reynolds
postCreditScene: The rebirth of the unified Marvel timeline where mutants, Avengers, and Fantastic Four co-exist.

title: Ghost Rider
shortSynopsis: The supernatural Spirit of Vengeance arrives in the MCU in February 2028, blazing a trail of hellfire across the underworld.
fullSynopsis: Stunt motorcyclist Johnny Blaze makes a binding pact with Mephisto to save a loved one, transforming into the skull-faced Spirit of Vengeance and launching the Midnight Sons.
castMembers: Cast Announcement Pending
postCreditScene: A hellfire chain wraps around a relic of the Darkhold.

title: X-Men: Mutant Genesis
shortSynopsis: Marvel Studios’ official feature film debut of the X-Men in May 2028, integrating mutant species into the prime continuity.
fullSynopsis: Following the dimensional restructuring in Secret Wars, the X-Gene awakens globally. Professor Charles Xavier opens Xavier’s School for Gifted Youngsters to guide Cyclops, Jean Grey, Storm, and Beast.
castMembers: Cast Announcement Pending
postCreditScene: Magneto stands on Genosha raising his helmet.

title: Black Panther 3
shortSynopsis: Wakanda enters a new technological and geopolitical era in December 2028, defending the vibranium mantle post-Secret Wars.
fullSynopsis: Directed by Ryan Coogler, the third chapter of Black Panther explores Wakanda’s role in the reconstituted world order following Secret Wars.
castMembers: Letitia Wright, Lupita Nyong’o, Winston Duke, Danai Gurira
postCreditScene: TBA

title: Spider-Man (2002)
shortSynopsis: Bitten by a genetically mutated spider, Peter Parker gains superhuman abilities and confronts Norman Osborn, the Green Goblin.
fullSynopsis: Tobey Maguire originates the modern cinematic superhero as Peter Parker. Battling Willem Dafoe’s iconic Green Goblin across New York City, Peter learns that with great power comes great responsibility.
castMembers: Tobey Maguire, Willem Dafoe, Kirsten Dunst, James Franco, Cliff Robertson, Rosemary Harris, J.K. Simmons
postCreditScene: None; Peter walks away from Norman Osborn’s grave, declaring his responsibility as Spider-Man.

title: Spider-Man 2 (2004)
shortSynopsis: Peter Parker struggles with failing powers and personal life as brilliant scientist Dr. Otto Octavius transforms into Doctor Octopus.
fullSynopsis: Struggling with poverty, failing grades, and fading powers, Peter Parker briefly walks away from his superhero life. However, when nuclear physicist Dr. Otto Octavius is controlled by four mechanical tentacles, Peter reclaims his mantle.
castMembers: Tobey Maguire, Alfred Molina, Kirsten Dunst, James Franco, J.K. Simmons
postCreditScene: Harry Osborn uncovers his father’s secret goblin lair and the green serum.

title: Spider-Man 3 (2007)
shortSynopsis: An alien black symbiote bonds with Peter Parker, amplifying his darker instincts as he battles Sandman, New Goblin, and Venom.
fullSynopsis: An extraterrestrial symbiote organism bonds with Peter’s suit, bringing arrogance and vengeance to the surface. He must overcome his inner demons while battling Flint Marko (Sandman), Harry Osborn, and Eddie Brock (Venom).
writers: Sam Raimi, Ivan Raimi, Alvin Sargent
castMembers: Tobey Maguire, Kirsten Dunst, James Franco, Thomas Haden Church, Topher Grace, Bryce Dallas Howard
postCreditScene: None; Peter and Mary Jane share a quiet slow dance at the jazz club.

title: The Amazing Spider-Man (2012)
shortSynopsis: Peter Parker investigates his parents’ disappearance, unlocking genetic secrets at Oscorp and battling the Lizard.
fullSynopsis: Teenage Peter Parker uncovers clues regarding his parents’ disappearance leading to Oscorp and Dr. Curt Connors. After a spider bite transforms Peter, Connors mutates into the reptilian Lizard, threatening all of Manhattan.
writers: James Vanderbilt, Alvin Sargent, Steve Kloves
castMembers: Andrew Garfield, Emma Stone, Rhys Ifans, Denis Leary, Campbell Scott, Irrfan Khan, Martin Sheen, Sally Field
postCreditScene: Gustav Fiers visits Dr. Connors in his asylum cell: "Did you tell the boy the truth about his father?"

title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2 (2014)
shortSynopsis: Peter balances his relationship with Gwen Stacy while Oscorp employee Max Dillon becomes Electro and Harry Osborn falls ill.
fullSynopsis: Peter discovers shocking secrets about his father’s cross-species research while confronting electrical powerhouse Electro (Jamie Foxx). When terminally ill Harry Osborn turns into the Green Goblin, it leads to the tragic clocktower fall of Gwen Stacy.
writers: Alex Kurtzman, Roberto Orci, Jeff Pinkner
castMembers: Andrew Garfield, Emma Stone, Jamie Foxx, Dane DeHaan, Campbell Scott, Embeth Davidtz, Paul Giamatti, Sally Field
postCreditScene: Gustav Fiers inspects the Oscorp vault containing Vulture wings and Doc Ock tentacles.

title: X-Men (2000)
shortSynopsis: Two mutants, Wolverine and Rogue, join Professor Charles Xavier’s school for the gifted while Magneto wages war against humankind.
fullSynopsis: In a world where mutants face discrimination, amnesiac brawler Logan (Wolverine) and runaway Rogue are saved by the X-Men. They learn to harness their gifts at Xavier’s school while opposing Magneto’s Brotherhood at the Statue of Liberty.
castMembers: Hugh Jackman, Patrick Stewart, Ian McKellen, Famke Janssen, James Marsden, Halle Berry, Anna Paquin, Rebecca Romijn
postCreditScene: Professor X plays chess with Magneto inside his plastic prison cell.

title: X-Men: First Class (2011)
shortSynopsis: In the 1960s during the Cuban Missile Crisis, young Charles Xavier and Erik Lehnsherr unite to form the original X-Men team.
fullSynopsis: Explores the origins of Professor X (James McAvoy) and Magneto (Michael Fassbender) during the Cold War. Teaming up against Sebastian Shaw’s Hellfire Club, philosophical divisions shatter their friendship into bitter enemies.
writers: Ashley Edward Miller, Zack Stentz, Jane Goldman, Matthew Vaughn
castMembers: James McAvoy, Michael Fassbender, Rose Byrne, Jennifer Lawrence, January Jones, Nicholas Hoult, Kevin Bacon
postCreditScene: None; Magneto breaks Emma Frost out of CIA custody and names their Brotherhood.

title: X-Men: Days of Future Past (2014)
shortSynopsis: Wolverine is sent back in time to 1973 to prevent an assassination that leads to the extinction of both mutants and humans by Sentinels.
fullSynopsis: Facing extermination in 2023 by adaptive robotic Sentinels, Kitty Pryde projects Wolverine’s consciousness back to 1973. Logan must unite the broken young Charles Xavier and Magneto to stop Mystique from assassinating Bolivar Trask.
castMembers: Hugh Jackman, James McAvoy, Michael Fassbender, Jennifer Lawrence, Halle Berry, Nicholas Hoult, Anna Paquin, Ellen Page, Peter Dinklage, Ian McKellen, Patrick Stewart
postCreditScene: In ancient Egypt, a young En Sabah Nur (Apocalypse) telekinetically constructs the pyramids while four horsemen watch.

title: Deadpool (2016)
shortSynopsis: A wisecracking mercenary undergoes a rogue experiment that leaves him with accelerated healing powers and a quest for revenge.
fullSynopsis: Special Forces operative Wade Wilson undergoes an underground mutant torture experiment by Ajax. Gifted with superhuman healing but severely scarred, Wade adopts the alias Deadpool, breaking the fourth wall to hunt down his creator.
castMembers: Ryan Reynolds, Morena Baccarin, Ed Skrein, T.J. Miller, Gina Carano, Brianna Hildebrand
postCreditScene: Deadpool steps out in a Ferris Bueller bathrobe telling the audience to go home, teasing Cable for the sequel.

title: Logan (2017)
shortSynopsis: In a grim future, an aging Wolverine cares for an ailing Professor X while protecting a young mutant girl named Laura (X-23).
fullSynopsis: In 2029, with mutant births eliminated, an aging and poisoned Logan works as a chauffeur to hide a senile Charles Xavier near the Mexican border. When cloned mutant girl Laura (X-23) arrives pursued by mercenaries, Logan embarks on one final journey of sacrifice. Serves as the anchor event for Earth-10005 in Deadpool & Wolverine.
writers: James Mangold, Scott Frank, Michael Green
castMembers: Hugh Jackman, Patrick Stewart, Dafne Keen, Boyd Holbrook, Stephen Merchant
postCreditScene: No post-credits scene; Laura turns Logan’s wooden cross grave marker on its side into an "X" symbol.

title: Deadpool 2 (2018)
shortSynopsis: Foul-mouthed mutant mercenary Wade Wilson brings together a team of fellow rogue mutants to protect a young boy from time-traveling cybernetic soldier Cable.
fullSynopsis: Following the death of Vanessa, Wade Wilson forms the X-Force to protect young mutant Russell Collins (Firefist) from cybernetic time-traveler Cable (Josh Brolin), mastering the power of family.
writers: Rhett Reese, Paul Wernick, Ryan Reynolds
castMembers: Ryan Reynolds, Josh Brolin, Morena Baccarin, Julian Dennison, Zazie Beetz, T.J. Miller, Brianna Hildebrand, Jack Kesy
postCreditScene: Wade repairs Cable’s time slider, saves Vanessa, shoots Weapon XI Deadpool, and shoots Ryan Reynolds before reading the Green Lantern script.

title: X2: X-Men United
shortSynopsis: The X-Men must unite with their enemy Magneto when military scientist William Stryker attacks the Xavier School.
fullSynopsis: Colonel William Stryker launches an assault on Xavier's School for Gifted Youngsters, capturing Professor X to weaponize Cerebro against all mutants. Wolverine, Storm, and Jean Grey join forces with Magneto and Mystique to infiltrate Stryker's Alkali Lake base, leading to Jean Grey's fateful sacrifice to save the team.
writers: Michael Dougherty, Dan Harris, David Hayter
castMembers: Patrick Stewart, Hugh Jackman, Ian McKellen, Halle Berry, Famke Janssen, James Marsden, Anna Paquin, Brian Cox, Alan Cumming
postCreditScene: Jean Grey's voiceover concludes as the fiery silhouette of the Phoenix glows beneath the waters of Alkali Lake.

title: X-Men: The Last Stand
shortSynopsis: A controversial 'cure' for mutancy polarizes the world while Jean Grey returns as the omnipotent, destructive Dark Phoenix.
fullSynopsis: The pharmaceutical discovery of a mutant gene cure sparks fierce conflict between Charles Xavier's peaceful integrationists and Magneto's militant Brotherhood. Meanwhile, Jean Grey reawakens with suppressed psychic godhood as the Dark Phoenix, leaving tragedy in her wake culminating in the climactic battle on Alcatraz Island.
castMembers: Hugh Jackman, Halle Berry, Ian McKellen, Patrick Stewart, Famke Janssen, Kelsey Grammer, Elliot Page, Shawn Ashmore
postCreditScene: Dr. Moira MacTaggert checks on a comatose patient who speaks in Charles Xavier's unmistakable voice, revealing his survival.

title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
shortSynopsis: Explores Logan's violent early life, his fierce rivalry with Victor Creed (Sabretooth), and the sinister Weapon X program.
fullSynopsis: Spanning more than a century from the Canadian wilderness in 1845 through the Vietnam War, mutant brothers Logan and Victor Creed are recruited into Colonel William Stryker's covert Team X. After walking away, Logan is targeted by Stryker and undergoes the agonizing surgical bonding of Adamantium to his skeleton.
castMembers: Hugh Jackman, Liev Schreiber, Danny Huston, Lynn Collins, Ryan Reynolds, Taylor Kitsch, will.i.am
postCreditScene: Weapon XI's severed hand claws from the rubble of Three Mile Island and Deadpool's head opens its eyes, breaking the fourth wall.

title: The Wolverine
shortSynopsis: Living as an exile haunted by Jean Grey's death, Logan travels to Tokyo where an old acquaintance offers to make him mortal.
fullSynopsis: Haunted by grief and guilt following the events of The Last Stand, Logan lives in isolation in the Yukon until summoned to Tokyo by Ichirō Yashida, a soldier he saved in WWII. Stripped of his healing factor by Viper, Logan must defend Yashida's granddaughter Mariko while battling Yakuza assassins, ninjas, and the towering Silver Samurai.
castMembers: Hugh Jackman, Tao Okamoto, Rila Fukushima, Hiroyuki Sanada, Svetlana Khodchenkova, Will Yun Lee, Famke Janssen
postCreditScene: Two years later at an airport, Charles Xavier and Magneto approach Logan, warning him of a dark new threat that will exterminate mutantkind (setting up Days of Future Past).

title: X-Men: Apocalypse
shortSynopsis: The ancient world's first and most powerful mutant awakens in 1983, recruiting Magneto and Four Horsemen to cleanse humanity.
fullSynopsis: Worshipped as a god since the dawn of civilization, the invincible mutant En Sabah Nur (Apocalypse) awakens into 1983 Cairo. Disillusioned with mankind, he recruits Magneto, Psylocke, Storm, and Archangel to cleanse the Earth. Raven and Professor X must lead a new class of young X-Men—including Cyclops, Jean Grey, Nightcrawler, and Quicksilver—into global battle.
castMembers: James McAvoy, Michael Fassbender, Jennifer Lawrence, Oscar Isaac, Nicholas Hoult, Rose Byrne, Tye Sheridan, Sophie Turner, Olivia Munn
postCreditScene: Men in black suits enter the Weapon X facility, retrieve vials of Logan's blood, and place them into a briefcase labeled 'ESSEX CORP', teasing Mister Sinister, X-23, and The New Mutants.

title: Dark Phoenix
shortSynopsis: During a perilous space rescue mission in 1992, Jean Grey absorbs a cosmic solar flare that unlocks apocalyptic psychic power.
fullSynopsis: In 1992, during a space shuttle rescue mission, Jean Grey absorbs a lethal cosmic force. Returning home, she discovers her telepathic and telekinetic power amplified beyond human comprehension, unleashing buried childhood trauma. As alien shapeshifter Vuk manipulates her power, the X-Men must decide whether to save Jean or destroy her to preserve humanity.
castMembers: James McAvoy, Michael Fassbender, Jennifer Lawrence, Nicholas Hoult, Sophie Turner, Tye Sheridan, Alexandra Shipp, Jessica Chastain
postCreditScene: Charles Xavier retires from the school, meeting Erik Lehnsherr at a Parisian café for a game of chess as a fiery Phoenix glimmers across the sky.

title: The New Mutants
shortSynopsis: Five young mutants held in an isolated psychiatric facility begin experiencing terrifying supernatural manifestations.
fullSynopsis: Mirage, Wolfsbane, Cannonball, Sunspot, and Magik are detained at Milbury Hospital under the psychiatric supervision of Dr. Cecilia Reyes. Believing they are in training for the X-Men, they discover they are test subjects for the sinister Essex Corporation, forced to unite their extraordinary abilities against the terrifying entity known as the Demon Bear.
castMembers: Maisie Williams, Anya Taylor-Joy, Charlie Heaton, Alice Braga, Blu Hunt, Henry Zaga
postCreditScene: The five young mutants escape the ruins of Milbury Hospital, venturing out into the world together as a new team.
